title: Thunder's leadership book (coordinated by Cris Pop), The shield: humility shields leaders from ego
summary: The chapter argues the shield a leader needs is humility, which guards against ego rather than hiding humanity. It says to be useful rather than look important, be easy to work with, stay open to being changed, and lift others as you climb. It reports Adi describing Thunder as a village where no one claims the storm as their own.

principles.text: Aim to be useful, not to look important; usefulness is what others actually feel.
principles.quote: Importance is what you claim. Usefulness is what others feel.

principles.text: Being easy to work with is part of leadership; attitude decides whether talent gets invited back.
principles.quote: Your talent might get you in the room, but your attitude decides if you get invited back.

principles.text: A mind full of pride has no room to learn; empty the cup to make space for possibility.
principles.quote: Your cup is either full of pride or full of possibility. It can’t be both.

principles.text: Thunder's stance on inclusion: everyone gets a seat by default, no one fights for one.
principles.quote: We, the Thunders, believe no one should be fighting for a seat at the table.

principles.text: Pay it forward: mentor and open doors for others, since success is never achieved alone.
principles.quote: Success is never a solo act.

principles.text: Humility is a team idea: your strength is multiplied through others, so lead by serving.
principles.quote: Humility is knowing that your strength is multiplied through others.
